fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Gum disease is the most common cause of tooth loss in adults, and it usually causes no discomfort at all until it is advanced. Caught early it is very treatable.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Gums that bleed when you brush, floss or eat something firm

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Red, puffy or tender gums rather than firm and pale pink

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Persistent bad breath or a bad taste that keeps returning

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Gums receding, so teeth look longer or feel more sensitive at the neck

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Teeth that feel loose, or that have shifted or splayed

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Food packing into spaces that didn’t used to be there

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A family history of gum disease or early tooth loss

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Diabetes, smoking or pregnancy - all raise your risk substantially

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We measure the pocket depth around every tooth, record bleeding points and recession, and take X-rays to see the bone level. This gives us a baseline and a diagnosis - gingivitis or periodontitis.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Scaling and root planing removes calculus and bacterial deposits from below the gum line and smooths the root surface so the gum can reattach. Done under local anaesthetic, usually over two or more visits by section.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Six to eight weeks later we re-measure. Healthy gums shrink, tighten and stop bleeding. We can show you the numbers changing, which is more convincing than being told.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Ongoing three or four monthly maintenance visits. Periodontitis is a chronic condition - it is controlled rather than cured, and the maintenance is what keeps it controlled.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Tenderness for a few days and cold sensitivity on exposed roots is expected.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Gums may look like they’ve receded slightly afterwards - that’s swelling reducing, which is the treatment working.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Soft food for a day or two if the area is sore.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Warm salt-water rinses, and a chlorhexidine mouthwash for a short period if we prescribe one.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Daily cleaning between teeth is non-negotiable from here - it is the single biggest factor in whether treatment holds.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: If you smoke, quitting improves the outcome more than anything we do in the chair.

fields.value: Adequate for gingivitis - the early, reversible stage where gums bleed but bone is intact.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Advanced bone loss, deep pockets that don’t respond, or cases needing regenerative surgery are better managed by a specialist. We refer when that’s appropriate.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Where a tooth has lost too much bone support, removing it can protect neighbouring teeth and let a proper replacement be planned.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: No treatment is risk-free, and you should hear this before you decide rather than afterwards.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Bone already lost to periodontitis does not grow back. Treatment stops further loss and stabilises what remains - it does not restore the original support.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Gum recession after treatment is normal as inflammation settles, and can leave teeth looking longer with more sensitive root surfaces.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Deep cleaning is done under anaesthetic and is uncomfortable afterwards for a few days.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Some teeth may feel looser briefly as swelling reduces before the gum tightens.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Without three or four monthly maintenance and daily interdental cleaning, the disease reliably returns.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Smoking substantially reduces success rates and masks bleeding, which hides the disease from you.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Diabetes and gum disease worsen each other in both directions - managing both matters.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Cost depends on how many quadrants need treating and how deep the pockets are. Most health funds rebate on periodontal treatment, though annual limits are often reached with a full course - we’ll help you plan across two calendar years where that saves you money, and payment plans are available.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Before anything starts you’ll have a written treatment plan with costs, inclusions and any conditions spelled out, plus an estimate of your health fund rebate checked at the desk.
